newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: U.N. agency brings food to drought-hit Mauritania.
newsitem.headline: U.N. agency brings food to drought-hit Mauritania.

text.p: The U.N. World Food Programme said on Thursday it had distributed 7,000 tonnes of food since July 28 to 200,000 people in parts of southern and eastern Mauritania affected by drought.
Rainfall in the crop-growing areas was as much as 60 percent below normal last year, cutting production of staple foods maize, sorghum and pearl millet.
The WFP estimated that the areas needed 34,000 tonnes of food and it was committed to providing half, with one third of this 17,000 tonnes of cereals bought in Mauritania.
The government has provided 4,000 tonnes so far and the European Union 3,000 tonnes.
